meta.name: Gram Chikitsalay
meta.description:
The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realise it is he who will have do change before anything else.

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 5/5

videos.title: Aaya Ram, Gaya Ram
videos.overview: Young and bright Dr. Prabhat leaves his father’s well-established city hospital to take up a challenging post at a neglected rural Primary Health Centre. But he quickly realizes that leave alone treating patients, his first obstacle would be to get to the PHC the way to which has been turned into farmland.

videos.title: Swayamsevi
videos.overview: Prabhat struggles to attract patients to the PHC as he encounters resistance from villagers who prefer the local quack doctor. Things get complicated when he finds out that the PHC medicines are being sold illegally by someone in the PHC.

videos.title: Jhootha Sudhir
videos.overview: Having treated no patients in two weeks, Prabhat’s troubles mount when he receives vaccines on Nurse Didi’s behalf, hands it over to her son, Sudhir, as she had wanted but Sudhir refuses blatantly that he took it.

videos.title: Bharosa
videos.overview: As political tensions escalate in Bhatkandi, Prabhat’s involvement in both rival election campaigns threatens his reputation, forcing him to take a stand against corruption while also discovering Sudhir’s mysterious behavior.

videos.title: Bohni
videos.overview: Prabhat uncovers Sudhir’s disorder and battles against the stigma of mental illness, persuading Nurse Didi to seek treatment for her son, all while navigating the complex dynamics of village politics and healthcare.

videos.title: Udhaar Aur Ghoos
videos.overview: As PHC patients rise, Prabhat struggles with medicine shortages while Dak Sab grows jealous. The Adarsh PHC Award may save them.

videos.title: Mehanga Shaukh
videos.overview: Gobind faces bribery to secure his job as Prabhat prepares the PHC for competition, while Dak Sab plots against them.

videos.title: Dekha-Dekhi Aur Checking
videos.overview: Dak Sab's fake puja lures the PHC staff away before inspection, wrecking their Adarsh PHC Award hopes as the Adarsh PHC jury nears.

videos.title: Pakadaua Vivaah
videos.overview: As the jury inspects the PHC, Gobind's chaotic marriage falters while Prabhat and Gargi have a face-off at his wedding.

videos.title: Daayan
videos.overview: While the Adarsh PHC award results are about to be out, Prabhat and Gargi unite to save a mother and child, restoring hope and faith in medicine.
